config.description: Price-only conditional-on-actual-fundamentals development screen, not an end-to-end accuracy benchmark
config.quarter_features: Four one-hot minute-within-hour indicators; existing fractional calendar and other features retained
config.interaction_features: Four centred quarter indicators plus a linear quarter phase and phase times three daily sine/cosine harmonics, all gated to the known native-price regime
limitations: One seed per candidate: exploratory screen, not an adoption gate
Native-only history retains 40 epochs and therefore has fewer optimizer updates; this is not a matched retune
Prices are conditional on actual fundamentals, not freshly forecast fundamentals
Interaction candidate added after observing early development folds; all candidates reported
